selection_rule: All four pre-existing held-out test cases in the 13-24 June Weddell validation fixture; no OSI-405-d or EfficientLoFTR outcome was inspected before selection.
osi_product: OSI-405-d v3.1 merged AMSR2+ASCAT Southern Hemisphere
osi_temporal_policy: For each trailing noon-to-noon segment, divide its daily OSI 48-hour displacement by its cell-specific duration and integrate only the SAR-overlap hours.
assisted_missing_policy: Use direct phase-correlation displacement when OSI-405-d is unavailable at a source tile.
truth_policy: Use the pre-existing spatially stratified direct-SAR endpoint fixture (target correlation >= 0.30, maximum 300 rows per case). This is a regional reproducibility reference derived from LiMOSAT/SAR, not independent accuracy truth.
independent_truth_limitation: The available AWI buoys are at 62-63 S and do not overlap these SAR pairs near 74 S.
